icons.name: ai-assistant
icons.heading: AI assistant
icons.description: The assistant thinks, then replies. Light: the orbit whips one turn round the core and comes to rest; as it lands the core flashes bigger (the answer forms) and the speech bubble swells once a beat later as the reply goes out, then both settle. Strong: the orbit winds back before the turn, overshoots its stop and settles; the core flashes harder and the bubble swells further with a second, smaller swing.

icons.name: system-instructions
icons.heading: System instructions
icons.description: The root issues a new rule and it is written into the tree. Light: the root node presses and sends; the spine runs on below the last rule and the new rule writes out to the right, overshoots its length a little and settles; the root springs back as the rule lands. Strong: the root presses harder, the instruction ripples down the existing rules in turn (each stretches out from the spine and springs back), then the new rule writes out, overshoots further and settles twice. Rules never leave the spine.
